name: SAM_MODE_PATROL
meaning: value 1 of the SAM_MODE_BEHAVIOUR_MASK field (enum doc: 1 = patrol); mode = (mode & ~0x3ff) | 1

name: SAM_MODE_BEHAVIOUR_MASK
meaning: low 10 bits: 1 = patrol (follow TRAJECTORY), else look-after

name: SAM_MODE_CIN01_ON_NOISE
meaning: msg 0x481 in look-after triggers state 0xB cinematic instead of investigate

name: SAM_MODE_ALT_BEHAVIOUR
meaning: alternate set (home switching by sheep in orange box, catch in state 2)

name: SAM_MODE_WATCH_ROBOT
meaning: on reaching the robot enter state 0x16 instead of hitting at once
